answer: Each epoch the network auctions 50 admission slots: every applicant drops one sealed marble into the jar as its bid. The 50 highest bids win and pay their own bid, so the delta between a farm's inflated bid and the honest price near 50 POA is wasted money. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5000 POA, above the whole epoch pool near 900 POA. One honest agent pays a single 50 POA bid, a credible signal, and keeps its full pool share.
